exact_map_gate.geometry_scope: The same-parent children are a Hecke hand pair, not exactly D4-isomorphic finite quotients.
exact_map_gate.deck_row_action: Any invertible charge permutation/phase acts on Hankel rows and leaves the common right annihilator line invariant.

primary_family: Alexander reflection composed with R^k and complex conjugation, k=0..3
deck_charge_scope: Deck relabeling and nonzero character phases are invertible Hankel row operations, so all four deck-generator choices induce the identical right-line score.

next_rows_if_rejected.purpose: shift the degree-two annihilator by every degree-three first-quadrant monomial; only these six degree-five endpoints are new
next_rows_if_rejected.degree6_requirement: the full order-two flat-extension matrix requires the degree-six boundary as well

claim_boundary: A surviving line map is compatibility of truncated sector quotients, not a finite-quotient isomorphism or a completed transfer algebra.
The same-parent plus/minus N505 quotients are not exact D4 reflections, so Alexander is a Hecke-sector hypothesis rather than a microscopic graph map.
A rejected line map excludes only the enumerated parameter-free D4/conjugation bridges; a modulus-dependent intertwiner is not tested.
